g.text: 1993 Grateful Dead Hour #242, May 1993 David Gans on KPFA. An hour of Dark Stars, in two parts.
1990 New Year's Eve 1990, the KFOG broadcast Oakland Coliseum live on FM, David Gans and Ken Nordine announcing. Lossless, forty tracks.
2020 Dead to the World, January 2020 Two Wednesday nights of David Gans's KPFA show, two hours each.
2022 Dead to the World marathon, February 2022 KPFA's annual marathon night with David Gans and Tim Lynch.
